name: auto-handoff
description: Compacts the conversation into a handoff once the context passes a threshold (30% of windows over 200k tokens, 50% of smaller ones) and files each handoff, with the durable knowledge it names, into an OKF bundle at .auto-handoff/ in the project root

largeWindowPercent.title: Handoff threshold for windows over 200k tokens
largeWindowPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the conversation is compacted into a handoff when the window is larger than 200k tokens.

smallWindowPercent.title: Handoff threshold for windows up to 200k tokens
smallWindowPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the conversation is compacted into a handoff when the window is 200k tokens or smaller.
